I love the background image and the text for subscribers, great job with it! Would you mind giving me an hand on how to implent it?

Setting a background image is done like so (replace $IMAGEURL with the url of the desired background image):

body {
 background: url( $IMAGEURL ) fixed center;
}

By subscribers you mean where it says "Splicers" and "splicers here now" right? This is done like the following. Replace $SUBSCRIBERS with whatever you want the subscribers to be called (ex "Splicers"), and $HERE with whatever you want the "here now" part to say (ex "splicers here now"):

.subscribers .word {
 display: none;
}

.subscribers::after {
 content: "$SUBSCRIBERS";
}

.users-online .word, .users-online .number::after {
 display: none;
}

.users-online .word, .users-online::after {
 content: "$HERE";
}
